C: › sailing a small sail in the shape of a triangle, positioned in front of the main sail on a boat
船首三角帆，主帆前的小帆
› engineering a long horizontal frame that sticks out from a crane and from which the hook hangs

NONE: › to be unwilling to do or continue with something
› If a horse jibs at something, it stops suddenly in front of it and refuses to move forward.

example: [ + -ing verb ] Although the tax is unpopular, the government has jibbed at abolishing it completely.
雖然這項稅收不得人心，政府也不願將之完全廢除。

NONE: › an insulting remark that is intended to make someone look stupid
› to make insulting remarks that are intended to make someone look stupid

example: Unlike many other politicians, he refuses to indulge in cheap jibes at other people's expense.
與許多其他政治家不同，他從不對他人濫加嘲諷。
She jibed constantly at the way he ran his business.
她不斷嘲笑他的經營方式。

NONE: › If one statement or opinion jibes with another, it is similar to it and matches it.

example: Her account of the accident jibes with mine.
她對意外的描述與我的一致。
